invalid_runs.failure: The reconciliation scenario wrapped a promotion prefix, but the binding validator accepted only an identical top-level scenario_id.
The boundary artifact omitted instance_spec_sha256, so strict three-way scenario/prefix/boundary binding rejected every run before provider invocation.

guardrails_added: A wrapped scenario may consume only the prefix scenario_id explicitly declared by its fixture.
The reconciliation family requires matching instance hashes in the scenario, prefix and failure boundary.
Boundary and reference artifacts now carry the instance hash.
The native replay audit rejects any boundary or reference whose instance hash differs from the prefix before a model is called.
